name: Race Dashboard
description: Glanceable speed and gear display driven by the simulator shift indicator, car RPM thresholds, and limiter state.
author: ApexHUD

settings.label: Approaching shift point
settings.help: The gear turns yellow as the simulator shift indicator begins to build.

settings.label: Shift now
settings.help: Flashing starts only when the simulator indicator is full or the rev limiter is active.

settings.label: Low RPM hint
settings.help: A blue gear is a gentle low-RPM hint, not a car-specific command.
